verdict.rationale: Xero provides a full accounting API, SDKs, OpenAPI spec, and an official MCP server with Chart of Accounts and invoice management capabilities, which an agent could use to draft journal entries programmatically. However, there is no documented review-queue/approval workflow, draft-vs-post distinction for journal entries specifically, or accountant-facing review mechanism exposed via the API/MCP server. missing for 10: explicit journal entry draft/post API documentation, a review-queue or approval-hold feature for accountant sign-off, and evidence of an accountant-facing review UI tied to agent-created entries.
